ot_13971.notes: Composer: 'Arabian-atmosphere orchestral piece'. Bright, heroic, constant high energy (LRA 5.0); B-hijaz lines over a G-major orchestral bed (pitch profile C B D G F# E G# D#; global oriental 0.009, segments 75-90 s and 135-150 s +0.13). Drops 91.2 / 124.6 / 145.4 s, big hit 109.2 s, final hit rings at 163.6 s. Best structural fit: 60 s cut 104.81-164.81 = reveal hit at +4.42 s AND natural ringing end. 160 kbps mp3 source.

ot_20880.title: 太陽の絨毯、砂漠の彼方
ot_20880.title_en: Carpet of the Sun, Beyond the Desert (Track 1, normal version)
ot_20880.license: OpenTracks Audio Source Usage License (https://opentracks.com/help/articles/license/) - free, commercial use incl. online ads and TV commercials, NO credit required, no account; composer terms: site-compliant; see LICENSE_opentracks.txt
ot_20880.notes: Strongest maqam colour in the whole library: oriental 0.28 overall and +0.17..+0.33 in EVERY 15 s segment; pitch profile G D A F# C# C Bb Eb = Hijaz on D / Nawa-Athar on G. Composer: Arabian / Middle-East, sitar is the lead instrument (can read slightly Indian - check by ear), plus strings, guitar, percussion. Powerful, serious/dark rather than bright. Loud master (-8.9 LUFS). Hits 35.1 / 96.4 s, section drops 55.9 / 117.1 s; ending is soft (music stops 143.44 s, tail to 148.7) - put the logo impact on 143.4. Tracks 2 (heat-warped FX) and 3 (dance-beat) not downloaded.

ot_9389.title: ルフの翼
ot_9389.license: OpenTracks Audio Source Usage License (https://opentracks.com/help/articles/license/) - free, commercial use incl. online ads and TV commercials, NO credit required, no account; composer terms: site-compliant; see LICENSE_opentracks.txt
ot_9389.notes: Composer: 'ethnic piece that would play in an Arabian Nights story' (Roc = the giant bird of the Arabian Nights - fits the falcon idea). Best reveal moment of the shortlist: quiet section 36-56 s, then a massive re-entry (hit 58.03 = strongest, 56.2/57.2 lead-ins), drop 80.6, final hit rings 106.9. Scale reads minor/diatonic overall (-0.117; +0.07..0.09 in the first 45 s) - less hijaz than #1/#2. Hot master (-9.4 LUFS, true peak above 0 dBTP after decode) - normalise/limit.
